tools.name: get_distance
tools.description: Flight distance in km between two airports (IATA code like 'VNO' or city/airport name).

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Check if EU261/EC261 applies to a route (departure or arrival in EU/EEA).

tools.name: get_compensation
tools.description: Estimate EU261 flight compensation (EUR 250/400/600) eligibility for delay/cancellation/denied_boarding. Indicative; final decision by claim partner.

tools.name: create_claim
tools.description: Submit a flight compensation claim (EU261). reservation_number = PNR (6-7 alphanumeric). flight_datetime 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Returns confirmation.

tools.name: get_airline
tools.description: Look up an airline by IATA code (e.g. 'AF', 'LH') or name. Returns name, IATA, ICAO.
